about: Side-market count models (corners, cards) for the prediction ledger - LEARNING ONLY, never tips or stakes. src/side_models/. A tracked league is served for a family only when its history is VERIFIED by two sources (see `verification`); every other tracked league is listed in the artifact with its reason and gets no rows. Statistics only - no prices are read or written.

corners.count: API-Football /fixtures/statistics 'Corner Kicks' per team (90 minutes), verified per fixture against football-data HC/AC

cards.count: API-Football /fixtures/statistics 'Yellow Cards' + 'Red Cards' per team (a card count, not booking points; a second-yellow dismissal is counted the provider's way - owner rule G9 still open), verified per fixture against football-data HY/AY/HR/AR (src/side_models/data.py)

verification.rule: per fixture: the two sources agree (src/side_models/data.py verify); per league x family: two-source overlap >= min_overlap_pct of the API-Football fixtures in the football-data window AND agreement >= min_agree_pct on that overlap

fixture_source: output/collect/upcoming_fixtures.parquet (API-Football fixture ids and team ids; refreshed by daily_injuries_lineups.yml)
